---
title: "Suppinger gastruloids"
---

Single-cell UMI counts and bulk HTSeq tables from the murine gastruloid
resource of Suppinger and colleagues (*Cell Stem Cell*, 2023; GEO
[GSE229513](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE229513)
and
[GSE229386](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE229386);
[@suppingerMultimodalCharacterizationMurine2023]). Download commands
belong in `data/raw/README.md`. Never overwrite `data/raw/`.

The scRNA-seq experiment is **one** technical 10x Chromium 3′ v3
resource, not a panel of independent biological replicates for GRNs or
for `DESeq2`. Zeros are molecule-sampling counts until proven otherwise
(@nte-drop-zico). GSE250136 is a later stem-embryo dataset and must not
be conflated with Suppinger.

## Hierarchical design {#sec-geo-design}

The single-cell reference is nested. The first factor is the mESC
**cell line** (B-S versus SBR). The second factor is the **time slot**
(@fig-cell-line-time).

![Single-cell hierarchy for GSE229513: cell line first, time slot
second. Only 48 h is observed in both lines.](images/suppinger_cell_line_time_design.png){#fig-cell-line-time}

```{mermaid}
%%| echo: false
%%| label: fig-suppinger-design
%%| fig-cap: "Two trees. Single-cell: cell line, then one leaf per time slot (48 h is drawn twice, once under each line). Bulk: Wnt schedule, then one leaf per time, each with three biological replicates."
%%{init: {"theme": "sandstone", "flowchart": {"htmlLabels": true}}}%%
flowchart TD
  SC["scRNA-seq GSE229513"] --> BS["Cell line B-S"]
  SC --> SBR["Cell line SBR"]
  BS --> BS48["48 h"]
  BS --> BS52["52 h"]
  BS --> BS56["56 h"]
  BS --> BS96["96 h"]
  BS --> BS108["108 h"]
  BS --> BS120["120 h"]
  SBR --> S24["24 h"]
  SBR --> S36["36 h"]
  SBR --> S48["48 h"]
  SBR --> S60["60 h"]
  SBR --> S72["72 h"]
  SBR --> S84["84 h"]
  BK["Bulk RNA-seq GSE229386"] --> W1["Standard Wnt pulse at 48 h"]
  BK --> W2["Early Wnt pulse at 24 h"]
  W1 --> W148["48 h, 3 replicates"]
  W1 --> W172["72 h, 3 replicates"]
  W1 --> W196["96 h, 3 replicates"]
  W2 --> W248["48 h, 3 replicates"]
  W2 --> W272["72 h, 3 replicates"]
  W2 --> W296["96 h, 3 replicates"]
```

**Single-cell (GSE229513).** Cell line is **confounded with time**: only
48 h has both lines; every other slot is a single line. We therefore
**do not** put cell line in the GRN design. Developmental trajectories
of B-S and SBR are treated as equivalent for type-level Gaussians
(@fig-bio-space). Networks are learned independently per labelled type
at the bulk-matched times 48 h, 72 h and 96 h only.

**Bulk RNA-seq (GSE229386).** First factor: the Wnt schedule — standard
pulse at 48 h versus a premature pulse at 24 h. Second factor: **three
biological replicates** at each of 48 h, 72 h and 96 h, drawn as
separate leaves in @fig-suppinger-design.

## Seurat processing {#sec-seurat}

Embeddings, QC and clustering follow the Seurat workflow of the
Suppinger gastruloid resource
[@suppingerMultimodalCharacterizationMurine2023] in
@fig-seurat-workflow (Alevin counts, `scater` QC, `SCTransform` Pearson
residuals **per batch** for integration, CCA, PCA, UMAP, Louvain). That
residualisation is for **integration and visualisation**. It is not the
observation table of the graphical lasso
(@sec-grn-observation, @sec-fs-hvg).

![Seurat workflow used to extract embeddings and downstream analyses on
GSE229513.](images/suppinger_seurat_workflow_single_cell.png){#fig-seurat-workflow}

## Biological interpretation from single-cell compositions {#sec-bio-sc}

@fig-bio-lineage and @fig-bio-space summarise a **putative** reading of
annotated type proportions along gastruloid time. They are not a
reconstruction of embryonic lineages. Two annotated states are treated
as technical artefacts of culture stress. The working caudal sequence
after the Chir/Wnt pulse is pluripotency $\to$ epiblast $\to$ primitive
streak $\to$ caudal mesoderm / NMP $\to$ pre-somitic mesoderm / somites,
with a residual endoderm bias typical of gastruloids.

![Putative lineage reading of Suppinger annotations (disclaimer: not a
ground-truth DAG).](images/suppinger_biological_itepreation.png){#fig-bio-lineage}

![Spatial / time-slot sketch of type composition, including the B-S and
SBR series.](images/suppinger_biological_itepreation_2.png){#fig-bio-space}

The early-versus-standard Wnt reading of bulk compositions is in
@sec-bio-deconv, after the mean-based comparators of
@sec-deconv-models.
